examples: We had to postpone the meeting because several managers were out sick this week.
ما مجبور شدیم جلسه را به تعویق بیندازیم چون چند مدیر این هفته بیمار بودند.
If it keeps raining, the coach may postpone tomorrow's match until the weekend.
اگر باران ادامه پیدا کند، ممکن است مربی بازی فردا را تا آخر هفته به تعویق بیندازد.
She postponed her trip to Italy after her flight was canceled.
او سفرش به ایتالیا را بعد از لغو پروازش به تعویق انداخت.
miniContext: Scheduling conflicts come up all the time, and sometimes the best choice is simply to postpone an event rather than rush it. A company might postpone a product launch if early testing reveals problems, giving the team time to fix them properly. Friends often postpone a dinner plan when someone gets sick or has to work late. Learning to postpone gracefully, without constant excuses, is an important social and professional skill.

examples: Parents must consent in writing before the school can take students on the overnight trip.
والدین باید پیش از آنکه مدرسه بتواند دانش‌آموزان را به اردوی شبانه ببرد، رضایت کتبی بدهند.
The patient must consent to the procedure before doctors can proceed.
بیمار باید پیش از انجام عمل، رضایت خود را اعلام کند.
He refused to consent to the new contract terms proposed by his employer.
او حاضر نشد با شرایط جدید قراردادی که کارفرمایش پیشنهاد داده بود موافقت کند.
miniContext: Consent matters in many areas of life, from medical treatment to simple everyday agreements between friends. Doctors are required by law to get a patient's consent before starting any serious procedure. Parents, too, must consent before their children can take part in certain school activities. Understanding when someone needs to consent, and when they can refuse, is part of respecting other people's choices.

examples: The company announced a massive investment in renewable energy projects across the country.
شرکت از یک سرمایه‌گذاری عظیم در پروژه‌های انرژی تجدیدپذیر در سطح کشور خبر داد.
A massive earthquake struck the region, destroying hundreds of buildings.
یک زمین‌لرزه عظیم در آن منطقه رخ داد و صدها ساختمان را ویران کرد.
The old oak tree in the park is absolutely massive, towering over everything nearby.
درخت بلوط قدیمی در پارک واقعاً عظیم است و بر همه چیز اطراف خود سایه افکنده.
miniContext: News reports sometimes describe events using the word massive to show just how large or powerful something is. A massive storm can knock out power across an entire region in a single night. Engineers building a massive bridge must plan for weight, wind, and decades of use. Whether describing a building, a crowd, or a problem, massive signals that ordinary words simply aren't big enough.

examples: The doctor told her to take one capsule after every meal for two weeks.
دکتر به او گفت که بعد از هر وعده غذایی به مدت دو هفته یک کپسول مصرف کند.
The space capsule separated from the rocket and began its descent toward Earth.
کپسول فضایی از موشک جدا شد و فرود خود به سمت زمین را آغاز کرد.
Each vitamin capsule contains exactly the daily dose recommended by nutritionists.
هر کپسول ویتامین دقیقاً حاوی دوز روزانه‌ای است که متخصصان تغذیه توصیه می‌کنند.
miniContext: A capsule can refer to a small medicine container or to a vehicle that carries astronauts into space. Pharmacists often recommend a capsule over a tablet because it dissolves more smoothly in the stomach. During the mission, the capsule carrying the crew separated cleanly and parachuted safely into the ocean. Whatever its form, a capsule is designed to protect and deliver something valuable inside.

examples: Local volunteers work every weekend to preserve the old forest from illegal logging.
داوطلبان محلی هر آخر هفته برای حفظ جنگل قدیمی از قطع غیرقانونی درختان کار می‌کنند.
You should preserve important documents in a fireproof box at home.
شما باید اسناد مهم را در جعبه‌ای ضدحریق در خانه حفظ کنید.
The museum preserves thousands of ancient artifacts for future generations to study.
این موزه هزاران شیء باستانی را برای مطالعه نسل‌های آینده حفظ می‌کند.
miniContext: Communities often work hard to preserve old buildings, forests, and traditions before they disappear. A city council might vote to preserve a historic theater instead of tearing it down for new offices. Scientists preserve rare plant seeds in special vaults in case a species is ever lost. To preserve something well usually takes ongoing effort, not just a single decision.

examples: Human rights groups continue to denounce the government's treatment of political prisoners.
گروه‌های حقوق بشر همچنان رفتار دولت با زندانیان سیاسی را محکوم می‌کنند.
The senator stood up to denounce the corruption within his own party.
سناتور برخاست تا فساد درون حزب خودش را افشا کند.
Several journalists publicly denounced the company for hiding the pollution report.
چند روزنامه‌نگار علناً شرکت را به خاطر پنهان کردن گزارش آلودگی محکوم کردند.
miniContext: To denounce something is to criticize it publicly and strongly, often because it seems unjust. Activists gathered outside the courthouse to denounce the unfair verdict. Newspapers denounced the factory's owners after the pollution scandal became public. When people denounce wrongdoing openly, it can pressure those responsible to change their behavior.

examples: Every snowflake is unique, with its own tiny pattern of ice crystals.
هر دانه برف منحصربه‌فرد است و الگوی کوچک خاص خود را از بلورهای یخ دارد.
Her accent is unique among her classmates because she grew up on three continents.
لهجه او در میان هم‌کلاسی‌هایش منحصربه‌فرد است، زیرا در سه قاره بزرگ شده.
The artist tried to give each painting a unique color scheme so none would look alike.
هنرمند تلاش کرد به هر نقاشی ترکیب رنگی منحصربه‌فردی بدهد تا هیچ‌کدام شبیه هم نباشند.
miniContext: Every person has something unique about them, whether it's a talent, a habit, or a way of seeing the world. A chef might create a unique dish by combining flavors from two very different cuisines. Fingerprints are famously unique, which is why they are used for identification. Celebrating what makes someone or something unique, rather than expecting everyone to be the same, often leads to more interesting results.

examples: A sudden torrent of rain flooded the streets within minutes.
سیلابی ناگهانی از باران در عرض چند دقیقه خیابان‌ها را غرق کرد.
After the announcement, the company received a torrent of angry emails from customers.
بعد از آن اعلامیه، شرکت موجی شدید از ایمیل‌های خشمگین مشتریان را دریافت کرد.
The mountain stream turned into a raging torrent after days of heavy snowmelt.
رودخانه کوهستانی بعد از چند روز آب شدن شدید برف به سیلابی خشمگین تبدیل شد.
miniContext: A torrent is a fast, powerful flow, whether of water, words, or emotion. After the dam broke, a torrent of water swept through the valley within minutes. During the argument, she unleashed a torrent of complaints she had been holding back for months. Meteorologists warned that the storm could produce a torrent strong enough to flood low-lying roads.

examples: Many employees resent having to work overtime without any extra pay.
بسیاری از کارمندان از مجبور شدن به کار اضافه بدون دستمزد بیشتر دلخور هستند.
I don't resent him for leaving the company; I understand he needed a change.
من از او به خاطر ترک شرکت دلخور نیستم؛ می‌فهمم که به تغییر نیاز داشت.
She resented being compared to her older sister throughout her childhood.
او در تمام دوران کودکی از مقایسه شدن با خواهر بزرگ‌ترش دلخور بود.
miniContext: People often resent being treated unfairly, even when they don't say so directly. A younger sibling might resent always getting the smaller portion at dinner. Employees tend to resent managers who take credit for their work. Left unspoken, the urge to resent something can quietly damage a relationship over time.

examples: Please do not molest the animals in the sanctuary; observe them quietly from a distance.
لطفاً حیوانات را در پناهگاه آزار ندهید و از فاصله‌ای ایمن و بی‌صدا آن‌ها را تماشا کنید.
The sign warned visitors not to molest the nesting birds during the spring season.
تابلو به بازدیدکنندگان هشدار می‌داد که در فصل بهار پرندگان در حال لانه‌سازی را آزار ندهند.
Hikers are asked not to molest wildlife or disturb their natural habitat.
از کوهنوردان خواسته می‌شود حیات وحش را آزار نداده و زیستگاه طبیعی آن‌ها را مختل نکنند.
miniContext: In older and more formal English, to molest something simply means to bother, disturb, or interfere with it, especially in nature. Park signs often ask visitors not to molest the wildlife, meaning they should leave animals undisturbed. A biologist studying nesting birds is careful not to molest the eggs or the surrounding branches. The warning not to molest a habitat is really a reminder to observe without interfering.

examples: The sky turned gloomy just before the storm rolled into town.
آسمان درست قبل از رسیدن طوفان به شهر دلگیر و تاریک شد.
He felt gloomy all week after hearing the disappointing news about his job.
او بعد از شنیدن خبر ناامیدکننده درباره شغلش تمام هفته را دلگیر بود.
The old abandoned house had a gloomy, silent atmosphere that made visitors uneasy.
خانه متروک قدیمی فضایی دلگیر و ساکت داشت که بازدیدکنندگان را بی‌قرار می‌کرد.
miniContext: A gloomy day is dark, cloudy, and a little depressing, whether outdoors or in someone's mood. The forecast predicted a gloomy weekend with constant rain and almost no sunshine. After failing the exam, he felt gloomy for days, avoiding his friends. Old castles in horror films are almost always shown as gloomy, with shadows in every corner.

examples: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the concert has been moved to a different venue.
به دلیل شرایط پیش‌بینی‌نشده، کنسرت به مکان دیگری منتقل شده است.
An unforeseen delay in shipping meant the package arrived two weeks late.
یک تأخیر پیش‌بینی‌نشده در حمل‌ونقل باعث شد بسته دو هفته دیرتر برسد.
The budget had to be revised because of several unforeseen expenses during construction.
بودجه به دلیل چند هزینه پیش‌بینی‌نشده در طول ساخت‌وساز باید اصلاح می‌شد.
miniContext: Life is full of unforeseen events that no amount of planning can completely prevent. An unforeseen illness can disrupt even the most carefully scheduled vacation. Companies try to set aside emergency funds for unforeseen costs that pop up during a project. While some problems are predictable, truly unforeseen ones test how well people can adapt on short notice.
